English Words: verb: to avoid a bad choice; to avoid a pitfall
Chinese Usage in a Sentence: 这家餐厅服务很差，大家可以避雷。
English Usage in a sentence: This restaurant has poor service, so everyone can avoid it.
Notes: Internet slang meaning avoiding something disappointing, risky, or low quality. Literal lightning protection is 避雷针 or 防雷.

English Words: verb: to take off one’s shoes
Chinese Usage in a Sentence: 进屋前请先脱鞋。
English Usage in a sentence: Please take off your shoes before entering the house.
Notes: Opposite of 穿鞋.

English Words: verb: to draw a line; to mark a boundary
Chinese Usage in a Sentence: 请在纸上画一条直线。
English Usage in a sentence: Please draw a straight line on the paper.
Notes: Can be literal, or figurative: 画线 means setting a clear boundary or standard.

Chinese Usage in a Sentence: 这杯果汁是用鲜橙榨的。
English Usage in a sentence: This glass of juice is made from freshly squeezed oranges.
Notes: Usually means fresh oranges, especially in food/drink descriptions.

Chinese Usage in a Sentence: 下午茶时，她吃了一块甜饼。
English Usage in a sentence: She ate a sweet biscuit at afternoon tea.
Notes: A general word for a sweet baked snack; the exact type varies by region.

English Words: verb: to call out and stop someone
Chinese Usage in a Sentence: 我正要离开时，老师叫住了我。
English Usage in a sentence: Just as I was about to leave, the teacher called out and stopped me.
Notes: 叫 means call out; 住 adds the result that the person stops.

English Words: verb: to send money; to remit money
Chinese Usage in a Sentence: 他每个月都会寄钱给父母。
English Usage in a sentence: He sends money to his parents every month.
Notes: Can be through a bank transfer, remittance service, or mail; 汇钱 is more formal for transferring money.

English Words: verb: to face away from; to turn one’s back toward
Chinese Usage in a Sentence: 他背向窗户坐着，没有看见外面的雨。
English Usage in a sentence: He sat facing away from the window and did not see the rain outside.
Notes: Usually followed by a direction/object: 背向门口, 背向阳光.

English Words: verb: to have one’s back to; to face away from
Chinese Usage in a Sentence: 她背对着我，所以没有发现我进来。
English Usage in a sentence: She had her back to me, so she did not notice me come in.
Notes: Very similar to 背向. 背对着 is especially common in speech.

English Words: verb: to block the wind; to shelter from wind
Chinese Usage in a Sentence: 这面墙可以帮我们遮风。
English Usage in a sentence: This wall can shelter us from the wind.
Notes: Often paired with 挡雨: 遮风挡雨.

English Words: noun: the first session; the first edition
Chinese Usage in a Sentence: 第一届运动会将在下个月举行。
English Usage in a sentence: The first sports meet will be held next month.
Notes: Used for the first occurrence of a recurring event, competition, conference, or term.

English Words: fixed expression: indispensable; cannot be omitted
Chinese Usage in a Sentence: 安全检查是活动中不可少的一环。
English Usage in a sentence: Safety checks are an indispensable part of the event.
Notes: Usually appears as 不可少的一部分 / 不可少的一环. 必不可少 is more common.

English Words: noun: fried rice vermicelli; stir-fried rice noodles
Chinese Usage in a Sentence: 我早餐点了一盘炒米粉。
English Usage in a sentence: I ordered a plate of fried rice vermicelli for breakfast.
Notes: Common Southeast Asian Chinese dish. 米粉 refers to rice vermicelli/noodles.

English Words: noun: prawn noodles; shrimp noodle soup
Chinese Usage in a Sentence: 这家小贩中心的虾面很有名。
English Usage in a sentence: The prawn noodles at this hawker centre are very famous.
Notes: Common in Singapore/Malaysia. Usually noodles served in a prawn-based broth.

English Words: verb phrase: to add together; to combine
Chinese Usage in a Sentence: 把这两笔钱合起来，刚好够买礼物。
English Usage in a sentence: Add these two amounts of money together, and they are just enough to buy the gift.
Notes: Can mean combining things, people, numbers, or efforts.

English Words: verb: to grab recklessly; to scramble for
Chinese Usage in a Sentence: 大家不要乱抢，请排队领取。
English Usage in a sentence: Everyone, do not grab recklessly; please line up to collect yours.
Notes: Usually criticizes disorderly grabbing or fighting over things.

Chinese Usage in a Sentence: 学生们每周一都参加升旗礼。
English Usage in a sentence: The students attend the flag-raising ceremony every Monday.
Notes: Common in Singapore/Malaysia Chinese. In Mainland Chinese, 升旗仪式 is more common.

English Words: verb: to be sideways; to turn to one side
Chinese Usage in a Sentence: 他侧着身子从狭窄的门缝里走过去。
English Usage in a sentence: He turned sideways to pass through the narrow doorway.
Notes: Usually needs a following body part or position: 侧着身子, 侧着脸.

English Words: noun: 20% discount; 80% of the original price
Chinese Usage in a Sentence: 这件外套打八折，售价八十元。
English Usage in a sentence: This jacket is sold at 20% off, for eighty yuan.
Notes: 八折 means paying 80% of the original price, not paying 20%.

Chinese Usage in a Sentence: 百分之九十九的学生都通过了考试。
English Usage in a sentence: Ninety-nine percent of the students passed the examination.
Notes: Chinese percentages are stated as 百分之 + number.

Chinese Usage in a Sentence: 只有百分之一的人选择了这个答案。
English Usage in a sentence: Only one percent of people chose this answer.
Notes: Chinese percentages are stated as 百分之 + number.

Chinese Usage in a Sentence: 他喜欢看百科全书，也懂很多百科知识。
English Usage in a sentence: He likes reading encyclopaedias and also knows a great deal of general knowledge.
Notes: Usually appears in 百科全书 “encyclopaedia” or 百科知识 “general knowledge.” 百科 alone is less common.

English Words: fixed expression: never tiring of playing; enjoyable again and again
Chinese Usage in a Sentence: 这个游戏设计得很好，真是百玩不厌。
English Usage in a sentence: This game is designed very well; it never gets tiring to play.
Notes: Used for games, toys, activities, or entertainment that remain enjoyable after repeated use.

English Words: verb: to become someone’s apprentice; to formally take a master
Chinese Usage in a Sentence: 他想拜师学习传统武术。
English Usage in a sentence: He wants to become an apprentice to learn traditional martial arts.
Notes: Usually implies formally learning from a skilled master in martial arts, crafts, or traditional arts.

Chinese Usage in a Sentence: 老师用板擦把黑板擦干净。
English Usage in a sentence: The teacher used a board eraser to clean the blackboard.
Notes: Also called 黑板擦.

Chinese Usage in a Sentence: 学生今天买票可以享受半价。
English Usage in a sentence: Students can enjoy half-price tickets today.
Notes: Paying half of the original price. Similar to 打对折.

Chinese Usage in a Sentence: 这块牛排我要半生熟。
English Usage in a sentence: I would like this steak medium-done.
Notes: Often used for steak or eggs. For food safety, some foods should not be eaten undercooked.

Chinese Usage in a Sentence: 请在纸上画一个半圆。
English Usage in a sentence: Please draw a semicircle on the paper.
Notes: A shape equal to half of a circle.

English Words: verb: to dress up as; to disguise oneself as
Chinese Usage in a Sentence: 孩子在派对上扮成了超人。
English Usage in a sentence: The child dressed up as Superman at the party.
Notes: Usually followed by the identity/role someone becomes: 扮成医生, 扮成怪物.

English Words: fixed expression: defend one’s home and country
Chinese Usage in a Sentence: 士兵们决心保家卫国。
English Usage in a sentence: The soldiers were determined to defend their homes and country.
Notes: A patriotic expression, often used in history, military, and formal rhetoric.

Chinese Usage in a Sentence: 我们周末去打保龄球吧。
English Usage in a sentence: Let us go bowling this weekend.
Notes: 打保龄球 means “to bowl.”

English Words:
verb: to retain heat; to keep warm
adjective: insulated; heat-retaining
Chinese Usage in a Sentence: 保温杯能让热水保温更久。
English Usage in a sentence: A thermos can keep hot water warm for longer.
Notes: Common in 保温杯 “thermos” and 保温瓶. It focuses on retaining existing heat.

English Words: verb: to cup one fist in the other hand in greeting
Chinese Usage in a Sentence: 他抱拳向大家行礼。
English Usage in a sentence: He cupped one fist in the other hand to salute everyone.
Notes: A traditional Chinese greeting/gesture, common in martial arts, historical settings, and New Year greetings.

English Words:
verb: to binge eat; to overeat
noun: binge eating
Chinese Usage in a Sentence: 压力太大时，他有时会暴食；暴食会影响身体健康。
English Usage in a sentence: When under too much stress, he sometimes binge eats; binge eating can affect physical health.
Notes: Usually refers to eating an excessive amount, sometimes in a medical/psychological context.

Chinese Usage in a Sentence: 学校北面有一个足球场。
English Usage in a sentence: There is a football field on the north side of the school.
Notes: More conversational than 北部; can also refer to the north-facing side of something.

Chinese Usage in a Sentence: 他背部受伤，暂时不能运动。
English Usage in a sentence: His back is injured, so he cannot exercise for now.
Notes: More formal/anatomical than 背. Common in medical and exercise contexts.

English Words:
noun: strap; shoulder strap
noun: suspenders; baby carrier straps
Chinese Usage in a Sentence: 这个书包的背带太长了；父母用背带把婴儿固定好。
English Usage in a sentence: The straps on this backpack are too long; the parents secured the baby with carrier straps.
Notes: Usually straps worn over the shoulders, such as on bags, overalls, or baby carriers.

English Words: verb: to lean against; to be backed by
Chinese Usage in a Sentence: 他背靠着墙休息；这家公司背靠大型集团。
English Usage in a sentence: He rested with his back against the wall; this company is backed by a large group.
Notes: Can be literal physical support or figurative support from an organization/person.

English Words:
adverb: back to back
adjective: direct and candid
Chinese Usage in a Sentence: 两人背靠背坐着；大家背靠背地谈了问题。
English Usage in a sentence: The two sat back to back; everyone discussed the problems directly and candidly.
Notes: Literal for physical position. Figuratively, 背靠背谈话 means an open, direct discussion.

Chinese Usage in a Sentence: 请在这张纸的背面写名字。
English Usage in a sentence: Please write your name on the back of this sheet of paper.
Notes: Opposite of 正面. Used for objects, pages, cards, buildings, and directions.

Chinese Usage in a Sentence: 天气热，他穿着一件白色背心。
English Usage in a sentence: The weather was hot, so he wore a white sleeveless vest.
Notes: Usually a sleeveless garment. It can also mean an undershirt or a padded vest, depending on context.

English Words: verb: to be trapped; to be stranded
Chinese Usage in a Sentence: 大雨后，几名游客被困在山上。
English Usage in a sentence: After the heavy rain, several tourists were stranded on the mountain.
Notes: Usually passive: someone is unable to leave because of danger, an obstacle, or a disaster.

Chinese Usage in a Sentence: 我一辈子都不会忘记这件事。
English Usage in a sentence: I will never forget this for my whole life.
Notes: Usually used with a number or possessive word: 一辈子, 这辈子, 上辈子.

English Words: fixed expression: for example; for instance
Chinese Usage in a Sentence: 很多运动都能锻炼身体，比方说游泳和跑步。
English Usage in a sentence: Many sports can exercise the body, for example swimming and running.
Notes: More conversational than 例如. Used to introduce an example.

English Words:
verb: to compete; to vie with
noun: competition; contest
Chinese Usage in a Sentence: 两队将在决赛中比拼实力；这是一场精彩的比拼。
English Usage in a sentence: The two teams will compete in the final; this is an exciting contest.
Notes: Emphasizes competing in skill, strength, speed, or ability.

English Words: verb: to compare to; to liken to
Chinese Usage in a Sentence: 人们常把老师比作园丁。
English Usage in a sentence: People often liken teachers to gardeners.
Notes: Usually used in the pattern 把 A 比作 B.

Chinese Usage in a Sentence: 这条路又长又笔直。
English Usage in a sentence: This road is long and perfectly straight.
Notes: Can describe a road, line, body posture, or object with no curve.

English Words:
verb: to be essential; to be necessary
noun: essential item
Chinese Usage in a Sentence: 雨伞是雨季必备；地图也是旅行必备。
English Usage in a sentence: Umbrellas are essential during the rainy season; maps are also travel essentials.
Notes: Often used after a noun: 旅行必备, 上学必备, 厨房必备.

Chinese Usage in a Sentence: 将军奉命镇守边关。
English Usage in a sentence: The general was ordered to guard the frontier.
Notes: Common in historical, martial-arts, and fantasy settings.

English Words:
noun: screenwriter; scriptwriter
verb: to write or adapt a script
Chinese Usage in a Sentence: 她是一名编剧；这部电影由她编剧。
English Usage in a sentence: She is a screenwriter; she wrote the script for this film.
Notes: Used for film, television, theatre, and other scripted productions.

Chinese Usage in a Sentence: 这道菜用了扁豆和猪肉一起炒。
English Usage in a sentence: This dish uses flat beans stir-fried with pork.
Notes: A type of flat edible bean. In some regions, the exact vegetable called 扁豆 may vary.

English Words: adverb: everywhere; all over the ground
Chinese Usage in a Sentence: 秋天到了，地上遍地都是落叶。
English Usage in a sentence: Autumn has arrived, and fallen leaves are everywhere on the ground.
Notes: Often used for things spread densely across an area: 遍地开花, 遍地都是.

Chinese Usage in a Sentence: 天气热，孩子想吃一根冰棒。
English Usage in a sentence: The weather is hot, and the child wants an ice pop.
Notes: A frozen sweet treat on a stick. 冰棍 is also common.

Chinese Usage in a Sentence: 牛奶放在冰箱里。
English Usage in a sentence: The milk is in the refrigerator.
Notes: Can refer to the whole fridge or, in casual speech, its freezer compartment.

Chinese Usage in a Sentence: 博物馆展出了许多古代兵器。
English Usage in a sentence: The museum displayed many ancient weapons.
Notes: More literary/formal than 武器; common in historical and fantasy contexts.

Chinese Usage in a Sentence: 士兵们天亮前回到了兵营。
English Usage in a sentence: The soldiers returned to the military camp before dawn.
Notes: Common in military, historical, and fantasy narratives.

Chinese Usage in a Sentence: 病人躺在病床上休息。
English Usage in a sentence: The patient was resting in the hospital bed.
Notes: Usually a bed for someone receiving medical care.

English Words: verb: to take sick leave; to rest due to illness
Chinese Usage in a Sentence: 他因为发高烧，今天病休在家。
English Usage in a sentence: He is taking sick leave at home today because of a high fever.
Notes: Used in schools and workplaces. 请病假 is more common in everyday speech.

English Words:
verb: to broadcast; to report
noun: broadcast report
Chinese Usage in a Sentence: 主持人正在播报天气；我们刚听完新闻播报。
English Usage in a sentence: The presenter is broadcasting the weather; we have just finished listening to the news report.
Notes: Common for news, traffic, weather, sports, and public announcements.

English Words: verb: to fill a tooth; to have a cavity filled
Chinese Usage in a Sentence: 我有一颗蛀牙，明天要去补牙。
English Usage in a sentence: I have a cavity and will go get it filled tomorrow.
Notes: Usually refers to dental filling treatment for a cavity or damaged tooth.

English Words: fixed expression: to pretend to understand when one does not
Chinese Usage in a Sentence: 不懂就问，不要不懂装懂。
English Usage in a sentence: If you do not understand, ask; do not pretend that you do.
Notes: A criticism of someone who acts knowledgeable despite not understanding.

English Words: verb phrase: to be no less than; not to lose to
Chinese Usage in a Sentence: 这家小店的味道一点也不输给大餐厅。
English Usage in a sentence: The food at this small shop is no less good than that of big restaurants.
Notes: Often used to say something is equally good as, or not inferior to, something else.

English Words:
verb: not count; not be included
adjective: not really; not considered
Chinese Usage in a Sentence: 这次不算，我们再来一次。
English Usage in a sentence: This time does not count; let us do it again.
Notes: Can mean excluding something from a total, or saying it does not qualify as something.

Chinese Usage in a Sentence: 报名人数不限，任何人都可以参加。
English Usage in a sentence: The number of registrations is unlimited; anyone can take part.
Notes: Common in notices and advertisements: 不限年龄, 不限次数, 不限人数.

English Words: fixed expression: you’re welcome; no need to thank me
Chinese Usage in a Sentence: A：谢谢你帮忙。B：不用谢。
English Usage in a sentence: A: Thank you for helping. B: You’re welcome.
Notes: A standard casual response to 谢谢. 不客气 is also common.

Chinese Usage in a Sentence: 这件衣服的布料很柔软。
English Usage in a sentence: The fabric of this clothing is very soft.
Notes: Refers to material used to make clothes, curtains, bags, and similar items.

English Words: noun: stuffed bear; cloth teddy bear
Chinese Usage in a Sentence: 小女孩抱着布熊睡觉。
English Usage in a sentence: The little girl sleeps hugging a stuffed bear.
Notes: Usually a soft toy bear made of cloth.

Chinese Usage in a Sentence: 礼物盒上系着一条红色彩带。
English Usage in a sentence: A red ribbon is tied around the gift box.
Notes: Used for decoration, gifts, celebrations, and performances.

Chinese Usage in a Sentence: 傍晚的天空出现了美丽的彩云。
English Usage in a sentence: Beautiful coloured clouds appeared in the evening sky.
Notes: Often describes clouds lit by sunrise or sunset.

Chinese Usage in a Sentence: 请给我一张餐巾。
English Usage in a sentence: Please give me a napkin.
Notes: 餐巾纸 means a paper napkin; 餐巾 can also mean a cloth napkin.

English Words: verb: to hide treasure; to store valuables
Chinese Usage in a Sentence: 传说这座山里藏着宝；海盗把财宝藏宝在小岛上。
English Usage in a sentence: Legend says this mountain contains hidden treasure; the pirates hid their treasure on a small island.
Notes: Usually appears as 藏宝图 “treasure map,” 藏宝地 “place where treasure is hidden,” or 藏着宝. 藏宝 alone is less common.

English Words: verb: to worry about; to take trouble over
Chinese Usage in a Sentence: 你别为我的事操心，我能处理。
English Usage in a sentence: Do not worry about my matters; I can handle them.
Notes: Often expresses concern or taking responsibility for someone/something.

English Words: noun: straw boat; boat covered with straw
Chinese Usage in a Sentence: 《三国演义》中有“草船借箭”的故事。
English Usage in a sentence: There is a story called “Borrowing Arrows with Straw Boats” in Romance of the Three Kingdoms.
Notes: Mainly recognized through 草船借箭, a famous Three Kingdoms story.

Chinese Usage in a Sentence: 这本儿童书里有很多彩色插图。
English Usage in a sentence: This children’s book has many colourful illustrations.
Notes: Images included in a book, article, textbook, or document to support the text.

Chinese Usage in a Sentence: 他是这家咖啡店的常客。
English Usage in a sentence: He is a regular customer at this café.
Notes: Can refer to a frequent customer, visitor, or recurring participant.

Chinese Usage in a Sentence: 我早餐做了番茄炒蛋。
English Usage in a sentence: I made tomato scrambled eggs for breakfast.
Notes: Usually egg cooked by stir-frying. 番茄炒蛋 is a common home-style dish.

Chinese Usage in a Sentence: 天黑了，请记得打开车灯。
English Usage in a sentence: It is getting dark; remember to turn on the car lights.
Notes: Can refer to headlights, brake lights, or other lights on a vehicle.

Chinese Usage in a Sentence: 一支车队正缓慢地通过街道。
English Usage in a sentence: A convoy of vehicles is moving slowly through the street.
Notes: Usually a coordinated group of vehicles travelling together.

Chinese Usage in a Sentence: 这辆自行车的车链掉了。
English Usage in a sentence: The chain on this bicycle has come off.
Notes: Usually shorthand for 自行车链条. 链条 is the general word for a chain.

Chinese Usage in a Sentence: 他按响车铃，提醒前面的人让路。
English Usage in a sentence: He rang the bicycle bell to remind the people ahead to make way.
Notes: Usually a bell on a bicycle.

Chinese Usage in a Sentence: 公司会报销员工的车资。
English Usage in a sentence: The company will reimburse employees’ transport costs.
Notes: Common in Singapore/Malaysia Chinese. In Mainland Chinese, 车费 is more common.

English Words:
noun: vehicle seat
noun: bicycle saddle
Chinese Usage in a Sentence: 请系好安全带，坐稳车座；这辆自行车的车座有点高。
English Usage in a sentence: Please fasten your seat belt and sit firmly in the seat; this bicycle’s saddle is a little high.
Notes: Can refer to a seat in a vehicle or the saddle/seat of a bicycle.

English Words: verb: to form a pair; to come in pairs
Chinese Usage in a Sentence: 花园里的蝴蝶成双飞舞。
English Usage in a sentence: Butterflies in the garden flew in pairs.
Notes: Often used in 成双成对, describing two things or people appearing as a pair.

Chinese Usage in a Sentence: 士兵站在城楼上守望。
English Usage in a sentence: The soldiers stood watch on the city gate tower.
Notes: Common in historical, martial-arts, and fantasy settings.

Chinese Usage in a Sentence: 天亮时，城门缓缓打开。
English Usage in a sentence: At dawn, the city gate slowly opened.
Notes: Usually refers to a gate in a walled historical/fantasy city.

Chinese Usage in a Sentence: 她穿了一件橙色的外套。
English Usage in a sentence: She wore an orange-coloured coat.
Notes: Standard word for the colour orange.

English Words: verb: to drink milk; to nurse
Chinese Usage in a Sentence: 婴儿饿了，正在吃奶。
English Usage in a sentence: The baby is hungry and is nursing.
Notes: Usually refers to a baby drinking breast milk or milk.

English Words: verb: to hesitate; to be uncertain
Chinese Usage in a Sentence: 他迟疑了一会儿，才回答问题。
English Usage in a sentence: He hesitated for a moment before answering the question.
Notes: More formal than 犹豫 in some contexts; often describes a brief pause caused by uncertainty.

English Words:
verb: to pump water
verb: to draw water
Chinese Usage in a Sentence: 工人正在抽水排出积水；以前人们常从井里抽水。
English Usage in a sentence: The workers are pumping water to drain the standing water; in the past, people often drew water from wells.
Notes: Can mean pumping water out or drawing water from a source, depending on context.

Chinese Usage in a Sentence: 这双鞋有一股臭味。
English Usage in a sentence: These shoes have a bad smell.
Notes: Similar to 臭气; 臭味 is especially common for an unpleasant smell from an object.

English Words: verb: to send troops; to deploy forces
Chinese Usage in a Sentence: 国王决定出兵保护边关。
English Usage in a sentence: The king decided to send troops to protect the frontier.
Notes: Common in military, historical, political, and fantasy contexts.

English Words:
verb: to enter the stage/field; to appear
verb: to be sent off from a match
Chinese Usage in a Sentence: 主角一出场，观众就鼓掌；那名球员因犯规被罚出场。
English Usage in a sentence: As soon as the main character appeared, the audience applauded; that player was sent off for a foul.
Notes: Can mean appearing in a performance/sport, or leaving a match because of a penalty.

English Words: verb phrase: to have a traffic accident; to be in a car accident
Chinese Usage in a Sentence: 他昨天上班路上出了车祸。
English Usage in a sentence: He had a traffic accident on his way to work yesterday.
Notes: Also commonly said as 出交通事故, especially in formal contexts.

English Words: verb phrase: to break out in a cold sweat
Chinese Usage in a Sentence: 听到这个消息后，他吓得直出冷汗。
English Usage in a sentence: After hearing the news, he was so frightened that he broke out in a cold sweat.
Notes: Usually caused by fear, nervousness, shock, pain, or illness.

English Words:
verb: to stand out; to get ahead
verb: to come forward for someone
Chinese Usage in a Sentence: 他终于有了出头的机会；看到朋友受欺负，他决定出头帮忙。
English Usage in a sentence: He finally got a chance to get ahead; seeing his friend bullied, he decided to step in and help.
Notes: Can mean becoming successful/prominent, or intervening to support someone.

English Words:
noun: first day of the lunar month/year
noun: first year of junior secondary school
Chinese Usage in a Sentence: 我们初一要去拜年；她今年读初一。
English Usage in a sentence: On the first day of Lunar New Year, we will visit relatives; she is in her first year of junior secondary school.
Notes: Meaning depends on context. 大年初一 is Lunar New Year’s Day.

English Words: verb: to pass through; to weave through
Chinese Usage in a Sentence: 汽车在繁忙的街道中穿行。
English Usage in a sentence: Cars weave through the busy streets.
Notes: Usually describes movement through a place full of obstacles, people, or traffic.

English Words: verb: to spread throughout; to become known everywhere
Chinese Usage in a Sentence: 这个好消息很快传遍了全校。
English Usage in a sentence: This good news quickly spread throughout the whole school.
Notes: Usually follows the area reached: 传遍全国, 传遍全城.

Chinese Usage in a Sentence: 他看到队友的位置更好，就立刻传球。
English Usage in a sentence: He saw that his teammate was in a better position, so he immediately passed the ball.
Notes: Used in ball sports such as football, basketball, and volleyball.

English Words: verb: to brag; to boast; to talk big
Chinese Usage in a Sentence: 他总喜欢吹牛，说自己什么都会。
English Usage in a sentence: He always likes bragging, saying that he can do everything.
Notes: Usually negative or teasing. 牛皮 can also mean bragging.

Chinese Usage in a Sentence: 春雨过后，花园里的花开得更旺了。
English Usage in a sentence: After the spring rain, the flowers in the garden bloomed more vigorously.
Notes: Often used in descriptive or poetic writing.

Chinese Usage in a Sentence: 慈母总是牵挂着远行的孩子。
English Usage in a sentence: A loving mother always worries about her child who is far from home.
Notes: More literary and emotional than 母亲 or 妈妈.

English Words: verb: to join the army; to enlist
Chinese Usage in a Sentence: 他年轻时曾经从军多年。
English Usage in a sentence: He served in the army for many years when he was young.
Notes: More formal/literary than 当兵.

English Words: noun: crispy skin; crisp outer layer
Chinese Usage in a Sentence: 这只烧鸡的脆皮又香又脆。
English Usage in a sentence: The crispy skin of this roast chicken is fragrant and crunchy.
Notes: Common in food descriptions, such as 脆皮烧肉 and 脆皮鸡.

English Words: verb: to give a score; to grade
Chinese Usage in a Sentence: 请根据表现给每位选手打分。
English Usage in a sentence: Please give each contestant a score based on their performance.
Notes: Can be used in school grading, judging competitions, reviews, and ratings.

English Words: verb: to keep night watch; to announce the night hours
Chinese Usage in a Sentence: 古时有人夜里打更报时。
English Usage in a sentence: In ancient times, people kept watch at night and announced the hours.
Notes: An old practice involving night watchmen, often seen in historical stories.

English Words:
verb: to beat a drum
verb: to feel uncertain or nervous
Chinese Usage in a Sentence: 孩子在台上打鼓；考试前，他心里有点打鼓。
English Usage in a sentence: The child beat a drum on stage; before the exam, he felt a little uncertain.
Notes: 心里打鼓 is an everyday idiom for feeling uneasy or unsure.

English Words: verb: to tie a knot; to become tangled
Chinese Usage in a Sentence: 请把绳子打个结；我的头发都打结了。
English Usage in a sentence: Please tie a knot in the rope; my hair has become all tangled.
Notes: Can refer to intentionally tying knots or things becoming knotted/tangled.

English Words: verb: to punch a hole; to perforate
Chinese Usage in a Sentence: 请先在纸上打孔，再放进文件夹。
English Usage in a sentence: Please punch holes in the paper first, then put it into the file folder.
Notes: Used for paper, belts, walls, ears, and other objects that have holes made in them.

Chinese Usage in a Sentence: 外面下雨了，出门记得打伞。
English Usage in a sentence: It is raining outside; remember to use an umbrella when going out.
Notes: Similar to 撑伞. 打伞 is especially common in everyday speech.

English Words: verb: to break into pieces; to smash
Chinese Usage in a Sentence: 小猫把花瓶打碎了。
English Usage in a sentence: The kitten knocked over and broke the vase into pieces.
Notes: Usually implies an object is broken by a hit, fall, or careless action.

English Words: verb: to dispel; to abandon; to give up an idea
Chinese Usage in a Sentence: 听完解释后，她打消了疑虑。
English Usage in a sentence: After hearing the explanation, she dispelled her doubts.
Notes: Often used with thoughts or feelings: 打消念头, 打消顾虑, 打消怀疑.

English Words: noun: boast; exaggerated claim; big talk
Chinese Usage in a Sentence: 你别只会说大话，要拿出行动。
English Usage in a sentence: Do not just make big claims; take action.
Notes: Usually negative. 说大话 means boasting or making unrealistic claims.

English Words: noun: top general; key player; major talent
Chinese Usage in a Sentence: 他是公司销售团队的一员大将。
English Usage in a sentence: He is a key talent on the company’s sales team.
Notes: Literally a high-ranking general; figuratively an important, capable person in a group.

English Words: verb: to substitute teach; to teach in someone’s place
Chinese Usage in a Sentence: 王老师请假了，今天由李老师代课。
English Usage in a sentence: Teacher Wang is on leave, so Teacher Li is substituting today.
Notes: Usually refers to a teacher temporarily teaching another teacher’s class.

English Words: verb: to rely solely on; to depend only on
Chinese Usage in a Sentence: 单靠努力还不够，也需要正确的方法。
English Usage in a sentence: Relying on effort alone is not enough; you also need the right method.
Notes: Usually followed by a person, resource, or factor that is insufficient by itself.

English Words: verb: to play a stringed/keyboard instrument
Chinese Usage in a Sentence: 她每天晚上都会弹琴半小时。
English Usage in a sentence: She plays an instrument for half an hour every evening.
Notes: Usually means playing the piano in modern contexts, but can refer to playing other instruments called 琴.

Chinese Usage in a Sentence: 孩子们在地上玩弹珠。
English Usage in a sentence: The children are playing marbles on the ground.
Notes: Usually small glass balls used in children’s games.

Chinese Usage in a Sentence: 蛋类含有丰富的蛋白质。
English Usage in a sentence: Eggs are rich in protein.
Notes: A category term for eggs and egg products, often used in nutrition or food contexts.

Chinese Usage in a Sentence: 这把刀的刀片已经钝了。
English Usage in a sentence: The blade of this knife has become blunt.
Notes: Can refer to blades in knives, razors, cutters, or tools.

English Words:
verb: to navigate; to guide a route
noun: navigation system
Chinese Usage in a Sentence: 手机正在导航我们去机场；车上的导航显示前方要转弯。
English Usage in a sentence: The phone is navigating us to the airport; the car’s navigation system shows that we need to turn ahead.
Notes: Common for GPS navigation, but can also mean guiding a route more generally.

English Words: verb: to say goodbye; to bid farewell
Chinese Usage in a Sentence: 离开前，他向大家一一道别。
English Usage in a sentence: Before leaving, he said goodbye to everyone one by one.
Notes: More formal/literary than 说再见.

Chinese Usage in a Sentence: 朋友得了奖，大家都来向他道喜。
English Usage in a sentence: The friend won an award, and everyone came to congratulate him.
Notes: Used for congratulating someone on a happy event, such as a wedding, birth, promotion, or award.

English Words: verb phrase: to be unable to wait; cannot wait any longer
Chinese Usage in a Sentence: 孩子们等不及想打开礼物。
English Usage in a sentence: The children cannot wait to open the presents.
Notes: Often used with 想: 等不及想…… “cannot wait to…”

Chinese Usage in a Sentence: 时钟滴答滴答地响；雨水滴答滴答地落下。
English Usage in a sentence: The clock went tick-tock; rain dripped down.
Notes: Imitates the sound of a clock, dripping water, or light rain.

English Words: verb: to drip down; to fall in drops
Chinese Usage in a Sentence: 雨水从屋檐上滴落下来。
English Usage in a sentence: Rainwater dripped down from the eaves.
Notes: Focuses on liquid falling one drop at a time.

Chinese Usage in a Sentence: 士兵在海面上发现了敌船。
English Usage in a sentence: The soldiers spotted an enemy ship on the sea.
Notes: Common in military, historical, naval, and fantasy contexts.

Chinese Usage in a Sentence: 这座雕像固定在石头底座上。
English Usage in a sentence: This statue is fixed on a stone pedestal.
Notes: The bottom support of an object, machine, statue, lamp, or structure.

Chinese Usage in a Sentence: 天黑了，请带上电筒。
English Usage in a sentence: It is getting dark; please bring a flashlight.
Notes: Common in Singapore/Malaysia and some southern varieties. In Mainland Chinese, 手电筒 is more common.

Chinese Usage in a Sentence: 他躺在树下的吊床上休息。
English Usage in a sentence: He lay on a hammock under the tree to rest.
Notes: A bed/sling made of fabric or netting hung between two supports.

English Words: verb: to turn around; to reverse direction
Chinese Usage in a Sentence: 司机掉转车头，往回开去。
English Usage in a sentence: The driver turned the car around and drove back.
Notes: Usually used for changing the direction of a vehicle, body, or attention.

Chinese Usage in a Sentence: 小女孩跑过去叫爹爹回家吃饭。
English Usage in a sentence: The little girl ran over to call her father home for dinner.
Notes: An old-fashioned, regional, or childlike term for father. 爸爸 is the usual modern everyday word.

Chinese Usage in a Sentence: 他离家多年，一直思念爹娘。
English Usage in a sentence: He had been away from home for years and always missed his parents.
Notes: Traditional/literary term for one’s parents. 父母 is neutral and modern.

Chinese Usage in a Sentence: 请把箱子放在柜子的顶部。
English Usage in a sentence: Please put the box on top of the cabinet.
Notes: Can refer to the top of a building, object, page, screen, or structure.

Chinese Usage in a Sentence: 请用订书机把这几页纸订在一起。
English Usage in a sentence: Please use the stapler to fasten these pages together.
Notes: The tool used to staple papers. 订书钉 means “staples.”

English Words: verb: to start writing; to put pen to paper
Chinese Usage in a Sentence: 想好了再动笔写作文。
English Usage in a sentence: Think it through before you begin writing the composition.
Notes: Often implies beginning a piece of writing, drawing, or formal work.

English Words:
verb: to freeze to death
fixed expression: to be freezing cold
Chinese Usage in a Sentence: 小动物在严冬里可能会冻死；今天真冷，快冻死我了。
English Usage in a sentence: Small animals may freeze to death in severe winter; it is so cold today—I am freezing!
Notes: The second use is an exaggeration meaning “I am extremely cold.”

English Words: verb: to shake off; to shake down
Chinese Usage in a Sentence: 他抖落衣服上的灰尘；风把树叶抖落下来。
English Usage in a sentence: He shook the dust off his clothes; the wind shook the leaves down.
Notes: Used when shaking causes dust, water, leaves, or similar things to fall off.

Chinese Usage in a Sentence: 妈妈把豆子放进汤里煮。
English Usage in a sentence: Mum put beans into the soup to cook.
Notes: A general word for beans, peas, and similar legumes.

English Words: noun: reading material; publication for reading
Chinese Usage in a Sentence: 这本读物很适合小学生阅读。
English Usage in a sentence: This reading material is very suitable for primary-school students.
Notes: Often refers to books, magazines, or texts intended for a particular group of readers.

English Words:
verb: to block; to clog
noun: blockage; congestion
Chinese Usage in a Sentence: 大雨导致道路堵塞；水管被杂物堵塞了。
English Usage in a sentence: Heavy rain caused traffic congestion; the water pipe was clogged by debris.
Notes: Used for roads, pipes, airways, communication, and processes.

English Words: verb: to stop breathing; to die
Chinese Usage in a Sentence: 老人断气前一直握着家人的手。
English Usage in a sentence: Before the old man stopped breathing, he kept holding his family’s hands.
Notes: A serious/literary term for death, often used in narration. Do not use it casually about someone.

Chinese Usage in a Sentence: 他把球传给位置更好的队友。
English Usage in a sentence: He passed the ball to the teammate in a better position.
Notes: Used in sports, games, group work, and team settings.

English Words: noun: opposite bank; other side of the river
Chinese Usage in a Sentence: 我们搭船到河的对岸去。
English Usage in a sentence: We took a boat to the other side of the river.
Notes: Usually refers to the far side of a river, lake, sea channel, or other body of water.

English Words: verb: to squat down; to crouch
Chinese Usage in a Sentence: 他蹲下和孩子说话。
English Usage in a sentence: He crouched down to speak to the child.
Notes: Opposite of 站起来. Often used when lowering oneself close to the ground.

Chinese Usage in a Sentence: 淀粉和纤维素都属于多糖。
English Usage in a sentence: Starch and cellulose are both polysaccharides.
Notes: A carbohydrate made of many linked sugar units; used in biology, chemistry, and nutrition.

English Words: fixed expression: many thanks; thank you very much
Chinese Usage in a Sentence: 多谢你的帮忙！
English Usage in a sentence: Thank you very much for your help!
Notes: Polite and slightly more formal than 谢谢; common in spoken Chinese and writing.

English Words: verb: to dodge; to avoid; to escape
Chinese Usage in a Sentence: 他及时躲过了迎面飞来的球。
English Usage in a sentence: He dodged the ball flying toward him in time.
Notes: Emphasizes successfully avoiding something dangerous, unpleasant, or unwanted.

English Words: verb: to shelter from the rain
Chinese Usage in a Sentence: 下雨了，我们到屋檐下躲雨吧。
English Usage in a sentence: It is raining; let us shelter from the rain under the eaves.
Notes: Usually taking temporary cover until rain becomes lighter or stops.

English Words:
adjective: nauseating; disgusting
verb: to feel nauseous
Chinese Usage in a Sentence: 这股味道让我觉得恶心；他虚弱得一直恶心想吐。
English Usage in a sentence: This smell makes me feel disgusted; he is so weak that he keeps feeling nauseous.
Notes: Can mean physical nausea or strong disgust. Calling a person 恶心 can be insulting.

Chinese Usage in a Sentence: 老师带着孩子们唱儿歌。
English Usage in a sentence: The teacher led the children in singing a children’s song.
Notes: Simple songs made for young children.

Chinese Usage in a Sentence: 她今天戴了一对银色耳环。
English Usage in a sentence: She wore a pair of silver earrings today.
Notes: Usually jewellery worn through or on the ears.

Chinese Usage in a Sentence: 他从小学习拉二胡。
English Usage in a sentence: He has learned to play the erhu since childhood.
Notes: A traditional Chinese bowed string instrument with two strings.

English Words: verb: to stare blankly; to daydream
Chinese Usage in a Sentence: 他坐在窗边发呆，不知道在想什么。
English Usage in a sentence: He sat by the window staring blankly, and no one knew what he was thinking about.
Notes: Usually means being mentally absent, idle, or lost in thought.

English Words: verb: to turn red; to become red
Chinese Usage in a Sentence: 她一听到大家夸她，脸就发红了。
English Usage in a sentence: Her face turned red as soon as everyone praised her.
Notes: Can describe skin, eyes, objects, or a person blushing.

Chinese Usage in a Sentence: 她用发夹把头发夹起来。
English Usage in a sentence: She used a hair clip to pin up her hair.
Notes: A clip or pin used to hold hair in place.

Chinese Usage in a Sentence: 古埃及的法老拥有很大的权力。
English Usage in a sentence: The pharaohs of ancient Egypt had great power.
Notes: The title of the rulers of ancient Egypt.

Chinese Usage in a Sentence: 魔法师施展法术保护大家。
English Usage in a sentence: The magician cast a spell to protect everyone.
Notes: Common in fantasy, games, myths, and supernatural stories.

English Words: adverb: instead; on the contrary; unexpectedly
Chinese Usage in a Sentence: 我本来想帮他，反倒给他添了麻烦。
English Usage in a sentence: I originally wanted to help him, but instead I caused him trouble.
Notes: Introduces an unexpected result opposite to what was expected.

Chinese Usage in a Sentence: 她早上做了几个饭团带去学校。
English Usage in a sentence: She made several rice balls to bring to school in the morning.
Notes: A ball of rice, often with fillings. Japanese-style rice balls may also be called 饭团.

English Words: verb: to sell; to peddle; to traffic
Chinese Usage in a Sentence: 商店不能贩卖假货；警方正在调查非法贩卖文物的案件。
English Usage in a sentence: Shops must not sell counterfeit goods; police are investigating a case of illegally trafficking cultural relics.
Notes: More formal than 卖. It can sound serious/negative, especially with illegal goods, drugs, or people.

English Words: noun: tuckshop; snack shop; school shop
Chinese Usage in a Sentence: 学生在休息时间到贩卖部买饮料。
English Usage in a sentence: Students go to the school tuckshop to buy drinks during break time.
Notes: Common in Singapore/Malaysia, especially for a small shop in a school or workplace. In Mainland Chinese, 小卖部 is more common.

English Words: noun: square block; cube; square shape
Chinese Usage in a Sentence: 孩子用方块搭了一座小桥。
English Usage in a sentence: The child used blocks to build a small bridge.
Notes: Can mean a square-shaped block, cube, or a square area on a screen.

Chinese Usage in a Sentence: 这个盒子是方形的。
English Usage in a sentence: This box is square-shaped.
Notes: A general shape description. 正方形 specifically means a mathematical square.

English Words: verb: to protect against moisture; to keep dry
Chinese Usage in a Sentence: 饼干要放进密封盒里防潮。
English Usage in a sentence: Crackers should be kept in a sealed container to protect them from moisture.
Notes: Common for food, electronics, storage, walls, and packaging.

English Words: verb: to protect against the sun; sun protection
Chinese Usage in a Sentence: 去海边前要做好防晒。
English Usage in a sentence: You should protect yourself from the sun before going to the beach.
Notes: Often refers to preventing sunburn and UV damage. 防晒霜 means sunscreen.

Chinese Usage in a Sentence: 出门前记得擦防晒油。
English Usage in a sentence: Remember to apply sunscreen before going out.
Notes: Usually a liquid/oil-based sunscreen product. 防晒霜 is more common for cream sunscreen.

English Words: verb: to protect oneself; for self-defence
Chinese Usage in a Sentence: 她随身带着哨子防身。
English Usage in a sentence: She carries a whistle with her for self-defence.
Notes: Often used for tools, skills, or actions intended to keep oneself safe.

English Words: noun: roof; top of a house
Chinese Usage in a Sentence: 雨太大了，房顶开始漏水。
English Usage in a sentence: The rain was so heavy that the roof began to leak.
Notes: More conversational than 屋顶.

English Words:
noun: interview; interview programme
verb: to interview; to conduct an interview
Chinese Usage in a Sentence: 这档访谈节目采访了许多作家；记者正在访谈这位演员。
English Usage in a sentence: This interview programme has featured many writers; the reporter is interviewing this actor.
Notes: Common in media, journalism, research, and television.

English Words: verb: to shoot an arrow; to release an arrow
Chinese Usage in a Sentence: 弓箭手瞄准目标后放箭。
English Usage in a sentence: The archer released an arrow after aiming at the target.
Notes: Common in historical, martial-arts, fantasy, and archery contexts.

English Words: verb: to slow down; to reduce speed
Chinese Usage in a Sentence: 请放慢脚步，小心台阶。
English Usage in a sentence: Please slow down and watch the steps.
Notes: Can apply to walking, driving, speaking, music, and the pace of an activity.

English Words: verb: to add oil; to pour in oil
Chinese Usage in a Sentence: 锅热了以后，先放油再放菜。
English Usage in a sentence: After the pan is hot, add oil before adding the vegetables.
Notes: Common cooking instruction. It can also mean draining oil in a mechanical context.

English Words: verb: to race; to run at full speed
Chinese Usage in a Sentence: 听到消息后，他飞奔回家。
English Usage in a sentence: After hearing the news, he raced home.
Notes: Stronger and more vivid than 快跑; often used in narration.

English Words: noun: flying bird; bird in flight
Chinese Usage in a Sentence: 天空中有几只飞鸟掠过。
English Usage in a sentence: Several birds flew across the sky.
Notes: More poetic/descriptive than 鸟.

Chinese Usage in a Sentence: 科技正在飞速发展。
English Usage in a sentence: Technology is developing rapidly.
Notes: Can describe physical speed or rapid change/development.

English Words:
verb: to flutter; to fly upward
adjective: high-spirited; exuberant
Chinese Usage in a Sentence: 尘土在风中飞扬；他脸上洋溢着飞扬的神采。
English Usage in a sentence: Dust flew up in the wind; his face was full of high-spirited energy.
Notes: Can describe things moving in the air or a person’s lively, confident spirit.

Chinese Usage in a Sentence: 那只肥猫整天躺在沙发上睡觉。
English Usage in a sentence: That fat cat lies on the sofa sleeping all day.
Notes: Literal for a plump cat. It can also figuratively refer to a wealthy, privileged person, often critically.

Chinese Usage in a Sentence: 请把废纸放进回收箱。
English Usage in a sentence: Please put waste paper into the recycling bin.
Notes: Refers to unwanted/used paper suitable for disposal or recycling.

Chinese Usage in a Sentence: 风吹过时，窗边的风铃发出清脆的声音。
English Usage in a sentence: When the wind blew, the wind chime by the window made a clear sound.
Notes: A hanging decoration that rings when moved by the wind.

Chinese Usage in a Sentence: 上下楼梯时，请抓住扶手。
English Usage in a sentence: Please hold the handrail when going up or down the stairs.
Notes: Can refer to a stair rail, vehicle handhold, or armrest on a chair.

Chinese Usage in a Sentence: 有这样关心你的家人，你真有福气。
English Usage in a sentence: You are truly fortunate to have family who care about you like this.
Notes: Often means being blessed with a good life, family, health, or luck.

English Words: noun: father the king; royal father
Chinese Usage in a Sentence: 王子请求父王允许他出城。
English Usage in a sentence: The prince asked his father the king to allow him to leave the city.
Notes: Used in royal, historical, and fantasy settings. In ordinary families, use 父亲 or 爸爸.

English Words:
verb: to include; to come with
adjective: accompanying; additional
Chinese Usage in a Sentence: 这份套餐附带一杯饮料；请阅读附带的说明书。
English Usage in a sentence: This set meal includes a drink; please read the accompanying instruction manual.
Notes: Usually refers to something included in addition to the main item.

English Words: verb: to reschedule; to change the date
Chinese Usage in a Sentence: 因为天气不好，活动决定改期举行。
English Usage in a sentence: Because of bad weather, the event was rescheduled.
Notes: Common for meetings, events, appointments, flights, and deadlines.

Chinese Usage in a Sentence: 她穿着高跟鞋走路不太方便。
English Usage in a sentence: Walking in high-heeled shoes is not very convenient for her.
Notes: Shoes with raised heels; can be uncomfortable or unsuitable for some activities.

English Words: verb: to shout loudly; to cry out
Chinese Usage in a Sentence: 人群高喊着支持自己喜欢的球队。
English Usage in a sentence: The crowd shouted loudly in support of their favourite team.
Notes: Stronger than 喊; often used for slogans, excitement, or urgent calls.

English Words: noun: stilt house; house on stilts
Chinese Usage in a Sentence: 有些乡村地区的人住在高脚屋里。
English Usage in a sentence: In some rural areas, people live in stilt houses.
Notes: A house raised above the ground on posts, often to avoid flooding or animals.

English Words: verb: to raise high; to hold high
Chinese Usage in a Sentence: 大家高举旗帜，欢迎获胜的队伍。
English Usage in a sentence: Everyone held their flags high to welcome the winning team.
Notes: Can be literal, or figurative: 高举和平旗帜 “hold high the banner of peace.”

English Words:
verb: to be promoted
verb: to rise high
Chinese Usage in a Sentence: 听说他下个月要高升了；愿你步步高升。
English Usage in a sentence: I heard he will be promoted next month; may you rise steadily in your career.
Notes: Most commonly refers to career promotion. 步步高升 is a congratulatory expression.

Chinese Usage in a Sentence: 她是修电脑的高手。
English Usage in a sentence: She is an expert at repairing computers.
Notes: Can describe skill in sports, games, work, or any specific ability.

Chinese Usage in a Sentence: 小猴子在草地上翻了一个跟斗。
English Usage in a sentence: The little monkey did a somersault on the grass.
Notes: Also written 跟头 in some contexts. 栽跟斗 can literally mean falling, or figuratively suffering a setback.

Chinese Usage in a Sentence: 他跑得太快，差点摔了个跟头。
English Usage in a sentence: He ran too fast and almost took a tumble.
Notes: Can refer to a physical tumble. 栽跟头 also figuratively means failing or suffering a setback.

Chinese Usage in a Sentence: 明天我们得更早出发。
English Usage in a sentence: Tomorrow we need to leave even earlier.
Notes: Comparative form of 早; it needs a comparison or context.

Chinese Usage in a Sentence: 请大家爱护学校的公物。
English Usage in a sentence: Please take good care of the school’s public property.
Notes: Refers to property belonging to an organization, school, workplace, or the public.

Chinese Usage in a Sentence: 这个国家实行共和制度。
English Usage in a sentence: This country follows a republican system.
Notes: Usually appears in compounds such as 共和国 “republic” and 共和制 “republican system.”

Chinese Usage in a Sentence: 我姑妈住在新加坡。
English Usage in a sentence: My paternal aunt lives in Singapore.
Notes: Refers to one’s father’s sister. 姑姑 is a more common everyday term.

Chinese Usage in a Sentence: 这个古国曾经拥有灿烂的文明。
English Usage in a sentence: This ancient kingdom once had a brilliant civilization.
Notes: Often used in history, archaeology, fantasy, and storytelling.

English Words: verb: to worry about; to miss and care about
Chinese Usage in a Sentence: 母亲一直挂念着在外地工作的孩子。
English Usage in a sentence: The mother has always worried about and missed her child working away from home.
Notes: More emotional and literary than 想念; it combines missing someone with concern for their well-being.

English Words: verb: to close tightly; to shut securely
Chinese Usage in a Sentence: 出门前请把窗户关紧。
English Usage in a sentence: Please shut the window tightly before going out.
Notes: 关 means close; 紧 emphasizes that no gap is left.

Chinese Usage in a Sentence: 这部电影给我的整体观感不错。
English Usage in a sentence: My overall impression of this movie is good.
Notes: Often used in reviews for one’s impression of a film, event, product, or visual experience.

English Words: verb: to view scenery; to sightsee
Chinese Usage in a Sentence: 这个平台是观景的好地方。
English Usage in a sentence: This platform is a good place for viewing the scenery.
Notes: Usually used for enjoying natural or urban views.

English Words:
noun: official side; authorities
adjective: official; authorized
Chinese Usage in a Sentence: 请以官方发布的消息为准；这是官方授权的产品。
English Usage in a sentence: Please rely on information issued by the authorities; this is an officially authorized product.
Notes: Used for governments, organizations, companies, and their authorized information/products.

English Words: verb: to stroll around; to browse casually
Chinese Usage in a Sentence: 我们吃完饭去商场逛逛吧。
English Usage in a sentence: Let us stroll around the shopping centre after eating.
Notes: The repeated form makes the action sound casual and relaxed.

English Words: noun: ghosts and monsters; supernatural creatures
Chinese Usage in a Sentence: 这部故事讲的是山里的鬼怪。
English Usage in a sentence: This story is about ghosts and monsters in the mountains.
Notes: Common in folklore, horror, fantasy, and supernatural stories.

Chinese Usage in a Sentence: 孩子朝弟弟做了个鬼脸。
English Usage in a sentence: The child made a funny face at his younger brother.
Notes: Common phrase: 做鬼脸 “make a funny face.”

Chinese Usage in a Sentence: 请把果皮扔进垃圾桶。
English Usage in a sentence: Please throw the fruit peel into the rubbish bin.
Notes: Refers to the outer skin/peel of fruit.

Chinese Usage in a Sentence: 榴莲常被称为“果王”。
English Usage in a sentence: Durian is often called the “king of fruits.”
Notes: Usually used as a promotional or descriptive title, not a general everyday category.

Chinese Usage in a Sentence: 过街时请看红绿灯。
English Usage in a sentence: Please watch the traffic lights when crossing the street.
Notes: Usually appears as 过街时 or 过马路.

English Words: verb: to expire; to pass the valid date
Chinese Usage in a Sentence: 这盒牛奶已经过期了。
English Usage in a sentence: This carton of milk has already expired.
Notes: Used for food, medicine, documents, memberships, and deadlines.

Chinese Usage in a Sentence: 这家餐厅的海鲜很新鲜。
English Usage in a sentence: The seafood at this restaurant is very fresh.
Notes: Includes edible fish, prawns, crabs, shellfish, and other sea animals.

Chinese Usage in a Sentence: 天气转冷后，人们穿上寒衣保暖。
English Usage in a sentence: After the weather turns cold, people put on warm winter clothes.
Notes: More literary than 冬衣. It can also refer to traditional clothing offered to ancestors in certain customs.

Chinese Usage in a Sentence: 这件衣服的颜色好丑，我不想买。
English Usage in a sentence: The colour of this clothing is so ugly that I do not want to buy it.
Notes: 好 here intensifies the adjective, meaning “very/so.” It is blunt and can sound rude about people.

Chinese Usage in a Sentence: 请问阁下来自何方？
English Usage in a sentence: May I ask where you come from?
Notes: Very formal/literary. In everyday speech, use 哪里 or 什么地方.

Chinese Usage in a Sentence: 黑猩猩是非常聪明的灵长类动物。
English Usage in a sentence: Chimpanzees are very intelligent primates.
Notes: More specific than 猩猩; a black chimpanzee is not what the word means.

English Words: verb: to braise in soy sauce; red-cook
Chinese Usage in a Sentence: 今晚我们吃红烧鱼。
English Usage in a sentence: Tonight we are having soy-braised fish.
Notes: A Chinese cooking method using soy sauce and seasonings, often giving food a reddish-brown colour.

Chinese Usage in a Sentence: 他最近走红运，接连中了大奖。
English Usage in a sentence: He has been very lucky recently and has won several big prizes in a row.
Notes: Usually appears in 走红运 “to have a run of good luck.”

English Words:
noun: back door; rear entrance
noun: improper private connection/favouritism
Chinese Usage in a Sentence: 请从后门离开；他不想靠走后门得到工作。
English Usage in a sentence: Please leave through the back door; he does not want to get a job through unfair personal connections.
Notes: The figurative meaning is negative and refers to bypassing fair rules through connections.

English Words:
noun: backstage
noun: administrative backend
noun: powerful backing
Chinese Usage in a Sentence: 演员在后台准备；管理员可以在后台修改资料；他背后似乎有很强的后台。
English Usage in a sentence: The actors are preparing backstage; the administrator can edit information in the backend; he seems to have powerful backing.
Notes: Meaning depends on context: theatre, computing, or influential support.

Chinese Usage in a Sentence: 孩子坐在汽车后座上。
English Usage in a sentence: The child is sitting in the back seat of the car.
Notes: Usually refers to the rear seat of a car, bicycle, or motorcycle.

Chinese Usage in a Sentence: 孩子们在操场上比赛转呼啦圈。
English Usage in a sentence: The children are competing to spin hula hoops in the playground.
Notes: A large hoop spun around the waist or other body parts for play/exercise.

English Words: verb: to exhale; to breathe out
Chinese Usage in a Sentence: 医生让他深吸气，然后慢慢呼气。
English Usage in a sentence: The doctor asked him to breathe in deeply, then exhale slowly.
Notes: Opposite of 吸气 “inhale.”

English Words: verb: to mess around; to behave foolishly
Chinese Usage in a Sentence: 别胡闹了，快认真做事。
English Usage in a sentence: Stop messing around and get to work seriously.
Notes: Usually a criticism of childish, unreasonable, or disruptive behaviour.

Chinese Usage in a Sentence: 清晨的湖面平静得像一面镜子。
English Usage in a sentence: The lake surface in the morning was as calm as a mirror.
Notes: Refers specifically to the top surface of a lake.

Chinese Usage in a Sentence: 这座花园里花果繁多。
English Usage in a sentence: This garden has an abundance of flowers and fruits.
Notes: Usually appears in compounds or set phrases, such as 花果山. Alone it is relatively uncommon.

Chinese Usage in a Sentence: 蜜蜂飞到花上采集花蜜。
English Usage in a sentence: Bees fly to flowers to collect nectar.
Notes: The sweet liquid produced by flowers that attracts pollinators.

English Words: noun: flowering tree; tree with blossoms
Chinese Usage in a Sentence: 春天到了，路边的花树开满了花。
English Usage in a sentence: Spring has arrived, and the flowering trees by the roadside are in full bloom.
Notes: Refers to trees grown for or covered with flowers.

English Words:
noun: pattern; design; style
noun: trick; new variation
Chinese Usage in a Sentence: 这块布的花样很好看；这家店每天都推出新花样。
English Usage in a sentence: The pattern on this fabric is very attractive; this shop introduces new variations every day.
Notes: Can refer to decorative patterns, different styles, or creative/new ways of doing something.

English Words: verb: to slide down; to slip off
Chinese Usage in a Sentence: 书从桌边滑落到地上。
English Usage in a sentence: The book slid off the edge of the table onto the floor.
Notes: Usually describes something moving down/sinking off a surface smoothly.

English Words: verb: to turn into; to transform into
Chinese Usage in a Sentence: 冰雪在阳光下化成了水。
English Usage in a sentence: Ice and snow turned into water in the sunlight.
Notes: Usually describes transformation into another form. 化作 is a more literary near-synonym.

English Words: noun: bad things said about someone; slander
Chinese Usage in a Sentence: 不要在背后说别人的坏话。
English Usage in a sentence: Do not say bad things about others behind their backs.
Notes: Usually refers to negative, critical, or malicious comments about someone.

English Words:
noun: joyful song
verb: to sing joyfully
Chinese Usage in a Sentence: 人们载歌载舞，欢歌庆祝节日。
English Usage in a sentence: People sang and danced joyfully to celebrate the festival.
Notes: More literary than 快乐地唱歌; often used in festive descriptions.

English Words: verb: to gather joyfully; to reunite happily
Chinese Usage in a Sentence: 朋友们在春节期间欢聚一堂。
English Usage in a sentence: Friends gathered happily together during Lunar New Year.
Notes: Often used for a cheerful gathering after people have been apart.

English Words:
verb: to reply; to respond
noun: reply; response
Chinese Usage in a Sentence: 请尽快回复我的邮件；我还在等你的回复。
English Usage in a sentence: Please reply to my email as soon as possible; I am still waiting for your reply.
Notes: Common for messages, emails, comments, and official responses.

English Words:
verb: to savour; to recall with pleasure
noun: lingering aftertaste; fond recollection
Chinese Usage in a Sentence: 这道菜让人回味无穷；我还在回味那次旅行。
English Usage in a sentence: This dish leaves a lasting aftertaste; I am still fondly recalling that trip.
Notes: Can describe food’s lingering taste or pleasant memories/thoughts.

English Words:
verb: to echo; to resound
noun: echo; reverberation
Chinese Usage in a Sentence: 歌声在山谷中回响；远处传来一阵回响。
English Usage in a sentence: The singing echoed through the valley; a reverberation came from the distance.
Notes: Used for sounds repeating in a space, or figuratively for an idea/event having continuing effects.

Chinese Usage in a Sentence: 天气冷的时候，我们喜欢一起吃火锅。
English Usage in a sentence: When the weather is cold, we like eating hot pot together.
Notes: A shared meal in which ingredients are cooked in simmering broth at the table.

English Words: verb: to beat a drum; to drum
Chinese Usage in a Sentence: 比赛开始前，表演者击鼓欢迎大家。
English Usage in a sentence: Before the event began, the performers beat drums to welcome everyone.
Notes: More formal/literary than 打鼓 when it simply means striking a drum.

English Words: verb: to remember firmly; to keep clearly in mind
Chinese Usage in a Sentence: 老师的话你一定要记牢。
English Usage in a sentence: You must remember the teacher’s words firmly.
Notes: Stronger than 记住; it emphasizes not forgetting.

English Words:
verb: to remember things
verb: to record events
Chinese Usage in a Sentence: 他从很小就开始记事了；记者正在记事本上记录采访内容。
English Usage in a sentence: He began remembering things from a very young age; the reporter is recording the interview content in a notebook.
Notes: 记事 can mean having memories from childhood, or recording events. 记事本 means “notebook.”

Chinese Usage in a Sentence: 他们在比赛中获得了季军。
English Usage in a sentence: They won third place in the competition.
Notes: 冠军 is first place; 亚军 is second place; 季军 is third place.

English Words: fixed expression: put in a little more effort; keep it up
Chinese Usage in a Sentence: 再加把劲，你马上就能完成了。
English Usage in a sentence: Put in a little more effort, and you will be able to finish soon.
Notes: An encouraging phrase used when someone is close to finishing or succeeding.

English Words: noun: playing house; children’s pretend family game
Chinese Usage in a Sentence: 孩子们在角落里玩家家酒。
English Usage in a sentence: The children are playing house in the corner.
Notes: A children’s role-playing game in which they pretend to be family members or adults.

English Words: noun: oracle bone; tortoise shell and animal bone
Chinese Usage in a Sentence: 甲骨上刻着古代的文字。
English Usage in a sentence: Ancient writing was carved on the oracle bones.
Notes: Usually appears in 甲骨文, the ancient Chinese script carved on tortoise shells and animal bones.

Chinese Usage in a Sentence: 假日里，许多人会带家人出去游玩。
English Usage in a sentence: During holidays, many people take their families out for fun.
Notes: Usually means a public holiday, vacation day, or day without work/school.

Chinese Usage in a Sentence: 这座教堂有一个高高的尖顶。
English Usage in a sentence: This church has a tall pointed roof.
Notes: Usually describes the pointed top of a building, tower, roof, or object.

Chinese Usage in a Sentence: 这只鸟有一张又长又尖的尖嘴。
English Usage in a sentence: This bird has a long, pointed beak.
Notes: Can describe an animal’s beak/mouth, or sometimes a person’s sharp-looking mouth.

Chinese Usage in a Sentence: 我早餐吃了煎蛋和吐司。
English Usage in a sentence: I ate a fried egg and toast for breakfast.
Notes: Usually an egg cooked in a frying pan. 炒蛋 means scrambled/stir-fried egg.

Chinese Usage in a Sentence: 他在路上捡到钱后，交给了警察。
English Usage in a sentence: After he found money on the road, he handed it to the police.
Notes: Usually means finding and picking up money. 捡到钱 is more complete/natural than 捡钱 alone.

English Words: verb: to pick up a ball; to retrieve a ball
Chinese Usage in a Sentence: 球滚出场外后，他跑过去捡球。
English Usage in a sentence: After the ball rolled out of bounds, he ran over to retrieve it.
Notes: Common in ball games, practice, and playground settings.

English Words:
verb: to inspect; to review ceremonially
noun: formal inspection/parade review
Chinese Usage in a Sentence: 领导检阅了仪仗队；国庆节会举行阅兵检阅。
English Usage in a sentence: The leader inspected the honour guard; a military review is held on National Day.
Notes: Often used for military formations, ceremonial parades, or formal inspections.

English Words: verb: to subtract; to take away
Chinese Usage in a Sentence: 十减去三等于七。
English Usage in a sentence: Ten minus three equals seven.
Notes: The standard mathematical verb for subtraction. Opposite: 加上 “add.”

English Words:
noun: introduction; brief profile
verb: to introduce briefly
Chinese Usage in a Sentence: 请先看一下公司的简介；让我简介一下今天的流程。
English Usage in a sentence: Please first look at the company profile; let me briefly introduce today’s process.
Notes: As a noun, it is a short description/profile. The verb use is less common than 简单介绍.

English Words: verb: to have been built in
Chinese Usage in a Sentence: 这座桥建于一九八五年。
English Usage in a sentence: This bridge was built in 1985.
Notes: Usually followed by a year or period, especially in historical/building descriptions.

Chinese Usage in a Sentence: 这座博物馆由著名建筑师设计。
English Usage in a sentence: This museum was designed by a famous architect.
Notes: A professional who designs buildings and may oversee their construction.

English Words: verb: to gradually grow dark; to become dim
Chinese Usage in a Sentence: 天色渐暗，我们该回家了。
English Usage in a sentence: The sky is gradually growing dark, so we should go home.
Notes: Usually describes light, sky, colour, or a mood becoming darker.

Chinese Usage in a Sentence: 傍晚，人们喜欢到江边散步。
English Usage in a sentence: In the evening, people like to walk by the river.
Notes: 江 usually refers to a large river; 江边 means its bank or nearby area.

English Words: verb: to begin talking about; when speaking of
Chinese Usage in a Sentence: 讲起小时候的事，他总是很开心。
English Usage in a sentence: When speaking of his childhood, he is always very happy.
Notes: Usually followed by a topic: 讲起……; it introduces a subject someone starts discussing.

English Words: verb: to hand in an exam paper
Chinese Usage in a Sentence: 考试结束后，请马上交卷。
English Usage in a sentence: Please hand in your exam paper immediately after the examination ends.
Notes: Usually for submitting an exam/test paper. It can figuratively mean finishing a task.

English Words: verb: to engage in battle; to fight
Chinese Usage in a Sentence: 两国军队在边境附近交战。
English Usage in a sentence: The armies of the two countries fought near the border.
Notes: Used for military conflict, and figuratively for competing forces or opponents.

English Words: verb: to catch the ball; to receive a pass
Chinese Usage in a Sentence: 你站好，我把球传过去，你负责接球。
English Usage in a sentence: Stand ready—I will pass the ball over, and you catch it.
Notes: Used in ball sports or games. It may mean catching a thrown ball or receiving a pass.

English Words: verb: to connect; to get through by phone
Chinese Usage in a Sentence: 电话终于接通了。
English Usage in a sentence: The phone call finally connected.
Notes: Usually for phone calls, communication lines, electricity, or water being connected.

Chinese Usage in a Sentence: 你知道这条街的街名吗？
English Usage in a sentence: Do you know the name of this street?
Notes: A name assigned to a street or road.

English Words: verb: to go together; to form a group/companionship
Chinese Usage in a Sentence: 我们结伴去爬山吧。
English Usage in a sentence: Let us go hiking together.
Notes: Usually means joining with one or more people for company or safety.

English Words: verb: to make friends with; to form an association with
Chinese Usage in a Sentence: 他喜欢结交来自不同地方的朋友。
English Usage in a sentence: He likes making friends with people from different places.
Notes: More formal than 交朋友; can also refer to establishing professional or social connections.

English Words: verb: to become; to form into
Chinese Usage in a Sentence: 两人后来结为夫妻；这两个城市结为友好城市。
English Usage in a sentence: The two later became husband and wife; these two cities became sister cities.
Notes: Usually followed by a relationship/status: 结为夫妻, 结为朋友, 结为联盟.

Chinese Usage in a Sentence: 这对姐妹俩长得很像。
English Usage in a sentence: The two sisters look very alike.
Notes: 俩 means “two,” so this specifically refers to exactly two sisters.

English Words: adverb: by this means; taking this opportunity
Chinese Usage in a Sentence: 我想借此机会感谢大家的帮助。
English Usage in a sentence: I would like to take this opportunity to thank everyone for their help.
Notes: Formal wording used to connect an opportunity or event with a purpose.

Chinese Usage in a Sentence: 夕阳照在湖面上，泛起一片金光。
English Usage in a sentence: The sunset shone on the lake, creating a golden glow.
Notes: Often used in descriptive writing for sunlight, treasure, or a shining object.

Chinese Usage in a Sentence: 秋天的稻田一片金色。
English Usage in a sentence: The rice fields are a golden colour in autumn.
Notes: Can describe a literal gold colour or anything with a golden appearance.

Chinese Usage in a Sentence: 这枚戒指是用金子做的。
English Usage in a sentence: This ring is made of gold.
Notes: More conversational than 黄金. Can be literal metal or figurative for something precious.

Chinese Usage in a Sentence: 牌匾上的金字在阳光下闪闪发亮。
English Usage in a sentence: The gold lettering on the plaque shone brightly in the sunlight.
Notes: Usually appears in phrases such as 金字招牌 “gold-lettered signboard / prestigious reputation.”

English Words: verb: to follow closely; to keep up closely
Chinese Usage in a Sentence: 小狗紧跟在主人身后。
English Usage in a sentence: The puppy followed closely behind its owner.
Notes: Can be literal movement or figurative: 紧跟时代 “keep up with the times.”

English Words:
verb: to follow immediately
adverb: immediately after
Chinese Usage in a Sentence: 他发言结束后，紧接着轮到我上台。
English Usage in a sentence: After he finished speaking, it was immediately my turn to go on stage.
Notes: Often used as 紧接着, indicating that one event follows another without delay.

English Words: verb phrase: to show filial devotion; to fulfil filial duty
Chinese Usage in a Sentence: 他常回家陪父母，尽自己的孝心。
English Usage in a sentence: He often goes home to spend time with his parents and show his filial devotion.
Notes: Refers to caring for and respecting one’s parents or elders.

English Words:
verb: to enter a venue
verb: to enter the market/field
Chinese Usage in a Sentence: 观众开始进场；新产品下个月正式进场销售。
English Usage in a sentence: The audience began entering the venue; the new product officially enters the market for sale next month.
Notes: Most commonly means entering an event venue. In business, it can mean entering a market.

English Words: verb: to enter and exit; to go in and out
Chinese Usage in a Sentence: 请不要让陌生人随意进出办公区。
English Usage in a sentence: Please do not allow strangers to enter and leave the office area freely.
Notes: Can refer to people, vehicles, goods, or access to a place.

English Words: verb: to cry out in alarm; to scream
Chinese Usage in a Sentence: 她看到蛇后吓得惊叫起来。
English Usage in a sentence: She cried out in alarm after seeing the snake.
Notes: Usually a sudden loud cry caused by fear, shock, or surprise.

English Words:
verb: to frighten; to shock
noun: fright; shock
Chinese Usage in a Sentence: 突然的巨响惊吓了孩子；孩子受到惊吓后一直哭。
English Usage in a sentence: The sudden loud noise frightened the child; after the fright, the child kept crying.
Notes: Can describe the act of frightening someone or the shock/fear experienced.

English Words:
noun: elf; sprite; fairy-like being
adjective: clever; lively
Chinese Usage in a Sentence: 故事里的精灵住在森林中；这个孩子很精灵，学东西很快。
English Usage in a sentence: The elves in the story live in the forest; this child is very clever and learns things quickly.
Notes: The first meaning is common in fantasy. The adjective use is regional/colloquial and means bright or quick-witted.

Chinese Usage in a Sentence: 他到警局报失了钱包。
English Usage in a sentence: He went to the police station to report his lost wallet.
Notes: Common in Singapore/Malaysia and Taiwan. In Mainland Chinese, 公安局 or 派出所 may be more common depending on the office.

English Words: verb: to respect and care for the elderly
Chinese Usage in a Sentence: 学校举办活动，教育学生敬老爱老。
English Usage in a sentence: The school held an activity to teach students to respect and care for the elderly.
Notes: Often appears in 敬老爱老, a value of respecting and caring for older people.

Chinese Usage in a Sentence: 深夜的走廊里静悄悄的。
English Usage in a sentence: The corridor was completely quiet late at night.
Notes: A vivid, slightly literary word for a place with almost no sound.

English Words:
noun: giant
noun: great figure; towering person
Chinese Usage in a Sentence: 童话里的巨人住在高山上；他是科学界的巨人。
English Usage in a sentence: The giant in the fairy tale lives in the mountains; he is a towering figure in science.
Notes: Can mean a huge fictional person, or figuratively an exceptionally important person.

Chinese Usage in a Sentence: 外面突然传来一声巨响。
English Usage in a sentence: A loud bang suddenly came from outside.
Notes: Usually describes an unexpectedly very loud sound, such as an explosion or crash.

Chinese Usage in a Sentence: 这句话结尾要加句号。
English Usage in a sentence: A full stop should be added at the end of this sentence.
Notes: In Chinese punctuation, 。 is called 句号. It can figuratively mean an ending.

English Words:
noun: end of a play/drama
verb: the drama ends
Chinese Usage in a Sentence: 舞台上打出“剧终”两个字；这场争论终于剧终了。
English Usage in a sentence: The words “The End” appeared on the stage; this argument finally came to an end.
Notes: Literally marks the end of a play. Figuratively, it means something has ended completely.

English Words: verb phrase: from now; dating back from the present
Chinese Usage in a Sentence: 这座古城距今已有一千多年历史。
English Usage in a sentence: This ancient city dates back more than one thousand years.
Notes: Usually followed by a length of time: 距今……年.

English Words:
noun: curly hair
verb: to curl one’s hair
Chinese Usage in a Sentence: 她有一头卷发；她出门前把头发卷发定型。
English Usage in a sentence: She has curly hair; before going out, she curled and styled her hair.
Notes: As a noun, 卷发 means curly hair. For the verb, 卷头发 or 烫卷头发 is more natural.

Chinese Usage in a Sentence: 这只卷毛小狗看起来很可爱。
English Usage in a sentence: This curly-haired little dog looks very cute.
Notes: Often describes an animal or person with curly hair/fur. It can be a casual nickname.

English Words: noun: in the army; within military ranks
Chinese Usage in a Sentence: 他在军中学习了许多生存技能。
English Usage in a sentence: He learned many survival skills while in the army.
Notes: Used in military, historical, and fantasy writing. 中 means “within.”

English Words: verb: to start running; to begin a race
Chinese Usage in a Sentence: 发令枪一响，选手们立刻开跑。
English Usage in a sentence: As soon as the starting pistol sounded, the runners began running.
Notes: Common in sports and races. Also used figuratively for a project or process starting.

English Words: verb: to fire a gun; to shoot
Chinese Usage in a Sentence: 警察警告后才向空中开枪。
English Usage in a sentence: The police fired into the air only after giving a warning.
Notes: Can refer to firing a gun literally, or figuratively starting an attack: 先开枪.

English Words: verb: to carry away on one’s shoulder
Chinese Usage in a Sentence: 两个人一起把木箱扛走了。
English Usage in a sentence: Two people carried the wooden crate away together.
Notes: 扛 implies carrying something heavy on the shoulder or with great effort.

Chinese Usage in a Sentence: 学生把书放在课桌上。
English Usage in a sentence: The student put the books on the school desk.
Notes: A desk used by students in a classroom.

Chinese Usage in a Sentence: 战争过后，这座城市变成了一座空城。
English Usage in a sentence: After the war, this city became deserted.
Notes: Common in the phrase 空城计, a famous strategy from the Three Kingdoms story.

English Words: verb: to be busy for nothing; to work in vain
Chinese Usage in a Sentence: 地址弄错了，大家忙了一天却空忙一场。
English Usage in a sentence: The address was wrong, so everyone worked all day for nothing.
Notes: Usually appears in 空忙一场; 空忙 alone is less common.

English Words: fixed expression: to have worked for nothing; all effort was wasted
Chinese Usage in a Sentence: 门票已经卖完了，我们白跑一趟，空忙一场。
English Usage in a sentence: The tickets were already sold out, so we made the trip for nothing and all our effort was wasted.
Notes: Used when effort produces no useful result.

Chinese Usage in a Sentence: 博物馆里有一具巨大的恐龙骨架。
English Usage in a sentence: There is a huge dinosaur skeleton in the museum.
Notes: Can also be slang for an unattractive woman, which is insulting and should be avoided.

English Words:
noun: saliva
noun: drool; eager desire
Chinese Usage in a Sentence: 宝宝睡着时流了口水；看到美食，他都快流口水了。
English Usage in a sentence: The baby drooled while sleeping; seeing the delicious food, he was practically drooling.
Notes: Literal saliva, or figuratively strong desire for attractive food/items.

English Words: noun: trouser leg; leg tube of trousers
Chinese Usage in a Sentence: 这条裤子的裤管太宽了。
English Usage in a sentence: The legs of these trousers are too wide.
Notes: Refers to the long tube-shaped part covering the leg.

English Words: noun: trouser hem; bottom of trouser leg
Chinese Usage in a Sentence: 他的裤脚沾满了泥。
English Usage in a sentence: The hems of his trousers were covered in mud.
Notes: Usually the lower end of a trouser leg, near the ankle.

English Words:
adjective: kind and tolerant
adjective: broad and thick
Chinese Usage in a Sentence: 他为人宽厚；这张桌子的桌面又宽又厚。
English Usage in a sentence: He is kind and tolerant; this table’s top is both broad and thick.
Notes: For people, it means generous and forgiving. For objects, it describes width and thickness.

Chinese Usage in a Sentence: 这条河宽宽的，孩子不敢自己过。
English Usage in a sentence: This river is quite wide, so the child does not dare cross it alone.
Notes: A reduplicated, childlike/descriptive form. 宽宽的 is more natural than using 宽宽 alone.

English Words: verb: to scream wildly; to howl loudly
Chinese Usage in a Sentence: 狗听到雷声后不停地狂叫。
English Usage in a sentence: The dog kept howling loudly after hearing thunder.
Notes: Implies repeated, uncontrolled, or very loud calling/shouting.

Chinese Usage in a Sentence: 请把补充说明写在括号里。
English Usage in a sentence: Please write the additional explanation in brackets.
Notes: 圆括号 ( ) are parentheses; 方括号 [ ] are square brackets.

English Words: verb: to have diarrhoea; to have an upset stomach
Chinese Usage in a Sentence: 他吃了不干净的食物后开始拉肚子。
English Usage in a sentence: He started having diarrhoea after eating unclean food.
Notes: Casual everyday term. 腹泻 is the medical/formal term.

Chinese Usage in a Sentence: 这件古物的来历还不清楚。
English Usage in a sentence: The origin of this antique is still unclear.
Notes: Can refer to where something came from, its history, or someone’s background.

English Words: verb: to intercept; to stop and seize
Chinese Usage in a Sentence: 后卫成功拦截了对方的传球。
English Usage in a sentence: The defender successfully intercepted the opponent’s pass.
Notes: Common in sports, military, police, and computing contexts.

Chinese Usage in a Sentence: 他起床后伸了个懒腰。
English Usage in a sentence: After getting up, he had a good stretch.
Notes: Usually appears only in 伸懒腰 “to stretch lazily.” 懒腰 alone is uncommon.

English Words: verb phrase: to scoop up; to fish out
Chinese Usage in a Sentence: 他用网把掉进水里的球捞起来。
English Usage in a sentence: He used a net to fish the ball out of the water.
Notes: 捞 means scooping/fishing something out of water or another container; 起来 emphasizes the successful result.

English Words: noun: a very long time; ages
Chinese Usage in a Sentence: 我等了老半天，他才来。
English Usage in a sentence: I waited ages before he finally came.
Notes: Informal emphasis; much stronger than 半天 in casual speech.

Chinese Usage in a Sentence: 乐团今晚将在音乐厅演出。
English Usage in a sentence: The orchestra will perform at the concert hall tonight.
Notes: Pronounced yuètuán here. It refers to an organized group of musicians.

English Words: noun: paradise; amusement park; place of enjoyment
Chinese Usage in a Sentence: 孩子们在游乐园里玩得很开心。
English Usage in a sentence: The children had a great time at the amusement park.
Notes: Can mean an amusement park (游乐园), or figuratively an enjoyable “paradise.”

Chinese Usage in a Sentence: 雷声一响，孩子就躲进了房间。
English Usage in a sentence: As soon as the thunder sounded, the child hid in the room.
Notes: 雷 is lightning/thunder in broad use; 雷声 specifically means the sound.

English Words:
verb: to freeze; to refrigerate deeply
noun: freezing; frozen storage
Chinese Usage in a Sentence: 请把肉放进冷冻室冷冻；这些冷冻食品要尽快吃完。
English Usage in a sentence: Please freeze the meat in the freezer compartment; these frozen foods should be eaten soon.
Notes: More specifically freezing than 冷藏, which means chilled/refrigerated storage.

Chinese Usage in a Sentence: 天气不好，商场里显得很冷清。
English Usage in a sentence: The weather was bad, so the shopping centre seemed very quiet and empty.
Notes: Describes a place with few people or little activity; different from 安静, which can be pleasantly quiet.

English Words: noun: ceremonial gun salute; celebratory firework cannon
Chinese Usage in a Sentence: 庆典开始时，礼炮齐鸣。
English Usage in a sentence: When the ceremony began, ceremonial salutes boomed together.
Notes: Used for formal celebrations, national events, and ceremonial welcomes.

Chinese Usage in a Sentence: 孩子应该学习基本的餐桌礼仪。
English Usage in a sentence: Children should learn basic table etiquette.
Notes: Refers to accepted rules of polite or ceremonial behaviour.

Chinese Usage in a Sentence: 她穿着一条蓝色连衣裙参加聚会。
English Usage in a sentence: She wore a blue dress to the gathering.
Notes: A one-piece garment combining a top and skirt.

Chinese Usage in a Sentence: 傍晚的凉风吹来，让人觉得很舒服。
English Usage in a sentence: The cool evening breeze made people feel very comfortable.
Notes: Usually a pleasant, cool wind, especially in the evening or autumn.

Chinese Usage in a Sentence: 天气热时，她喜欢穿凉鞋。
English Usage in a sentence: When the weather is hot, she likes wearing sandals.
Notes: Open or ventilated shoes suitable for warm weather.

Chinese Usage in a Sentence: 她喜欢穿亮色的衣服。
English Usage in a sentence: She likes wearing brightly coloured clothes.
Notes: Usually refers to light, vivid, eye-catching colours. Opposite: 暗色.

Chinese Usage in a Sentence: “本”是用来数书的量词。
English Usage in a sentence: 本 is the measure word used for books.
Notes: A grammatical word used with numbers and nouns, such as 个, 本, 张, and 条.

English Words: verb: before departing; on the eve of departure
Chinese Usage in a Sentence: 临行前，母亲再三叮嘱他要小心。
English Usage in a sentence: Before he departed, his mother repeatedly told him to be careful.
Notes: More literary/formal than 出发前 or 临走前.

English Words:
noun: spiritual sensitivity; intelligence
noun: liveliness; intuitive quality
Chinese Usage in a Sentence: 这只小猫很有灵性；这幅画充满灵性。
English Usage in a sentence: This kitten seems very intelligent and perceptive; this painting is full of spiritual vitality.
Notes: Can describe a living creature’s sensitivity/intelligence or an artwork’s vivid, inspired quality.

Chinese Usage in a Sentence: 他周末做零工赚一点钱。
English Usage in a sentence: He does casual work on weekends to earn some money.
